name: dialnexa
description: Create and operate AI voice agents, launch outbound calls, and review call outcomes.

interface.longDescription:
Use DialNexa in ChatGPT to create and operate AI voice agents for sales, lead qualification, recruitment, reminders, collections, and customer engagement.

Configure an agent, launch outbound calls, monitor call progress, and review outcomes directly from the conversation. DialNexa helps teams reach contacts at scale through natural, multilingual phone conversations while turning every call into structured, usable data.

Automate repetitive calling workflows, follow up faster, and let your team focus on conversations that need a human.
defaultPrompt: Show me my DialNexa agents and which ones are published.
Summarize the outcomes of my last 10 DialNexa calls.
What happened on my most recent DialNexa call?

positive.expected_behavior: A roster of all the organization's agents, each with its agent id (agent_...), name, agent type, current version number, and creation date. This account has several named agents (for example a sales outreach agent and a support agent).
The organization's current wallet balance in INR, with the billing currency.

positive.prompt: Show my recent DialNexa calls and how each one went.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the organization's recent calls, each with its status (e.g. completed, did_not_pick, failed) and duration. This account has multiple completed calls with varied durations.

positive.description: Read what happened on a call
positive.prompt: What happened on my most recent completed DialNexa call? Give me the summary and transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent completed call and returns its post-call summary and transcript. A recording link is only returned if the user asks for the audio.

positive.prompt: What language, voice and AI model does my Support Follow-up Agent use?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Support Follow-up Agent and returns its current configuration: language English, voice Ryan Kurk, LLM GPT-4o Mini, current version 2.

negative.description: User asks for a personal reminder, not an outbound call
negative.prompt: Remind me to call my mom tomorrow evening.

negative.description: User asks ChatGPT to role-play as a support agent, not manage a DialNexa voice agent
negative.prompt: Act as a customer support agent and help me troubleshoot my printer.

negative.description: User asks for generic business-process workflow help unrelated to calling automation
negative.prompt: Help me design a workflow for approving employee expense reports.

publication.release_notes:
First release of DialNexa for ChatGPT:
- Create and update AI voice agents, and see which versions are published.
- Place outbound calls you confirm, and launch batch calls to your own contacts.
- Review call history, outcomes, summaries and transcripts, and get recordings on request.
- Manage knowledge bases, view workflows and their leads, see your phone numbers and assign them to agents, and check your wallet balance and spend limits.
Tools that place calls, spend credit or change your setup are labelled as such, so ChatGPT can ask you to confirm before using them.

Changes since the last submission:
- Reviewed tool annotations against the current guidelines and corrected 10 tools, including clean_batch_call_names (openWorldHint).
- Tool descriptions now state every side effect.
- Workflow building, integration connection, billing plans, number pricing and number purchases are no longer available in ChatGPT; they are done in the DialNexa dashboard.
- Webhook tools now show only the host of each webhook URL.
